regions.merged_text: God bless you again Mrs. Weithoff. You may well con- gratulate yourself and be consoled that yourself and your lately deceased Mother have been clients of our dear Bles- sed Mother Mary - under whatever title -- for whether as "Mystica Rose" or Mystical City" she remains the Blessed Mother of God and by His divine wisdom and power and mer- ciful condiscention blessed Mother of redeemed humanity, . therefore, our blessed Mother too. . -
